description: Works out when a claim form and particulars of claim are deemed served in England and Wales, and every date that follows: acknowledgment of service, the defence, agreed extensions and the earliest default judgment, with bank holidays and court closures. Also covers the Damages Claims Portal (PD 51ZB). Give the issue date, how and when the claim form was served, and how the particulars were served.

aos.description: Whether the defendant acknowledged service: "yes", "no" or "" if not known.

cfMethod.description: How the claim form was served (default first-class-post).

cfStep.description: The date of the step taken to serve the claim form (posting, sending, delivering) (YYYY-MM-DD).

cfTime.description: The time of that step, where the method is timed (24-hour HH:MM). Leave out if not known.

courtDeemed.description: Where the court served the claim form: the deemed service date on its notice (YYYY-MM-DD).

extension.description: Days of extension for the defence agreed under CPR 15.5 (up to 28), e.g. "28".

issue.description: The date the claim form was issued (YYYY-MM-DD).

poc.description: Whether the particulars of claim are in the claim form, served with it (default), or to follow.

pocDate.description: Where the particulars followed: the date of the step taken to serve them (YYYY-MM-DD).

pocMethod.description: Where the particulars followed: how they were served.

pocTime.description: Where the particulars followed: the time of that step (24-hour HH:MM). Leave out if not known.

route.description: "part7" for a claim served under Part 6 (default), "dcp" for the Damages Claims Portal.

servedBy.description: Who served the claim form (default claimant).

special.description: Leave "" unless service was outside the jurisdiction, on the Crown, or by an alternative method ordered by the court.

name: calculate_deemed_service
title: Deemed service calculator (CPR 6.14, 6.26, 10.3, 15.4)
